policy.source: All648 consumed, exact prepared clips in162 known source components; four source-disjoint roles. No fresh reserve used.
policy.positions: Frozen half-second centers and native consecutive triplets; three middle, two before and two after centers. No authenticity response chooses positions.
policy.truth: Audited changed RGB source-frame presence in sampled support. Publisher manipulation labels, not identified-face or pixel-authorship ground truth.
policy.views: Unchanged commercial GenD face-crop logit, SFace appearance transition, DINOv2 patch feature transition. One visible detected face; no identity database.
policy.native: YuNet and SFace CPU; GenD and DINOv2 MPSfloat32. Fixed crop batch8 and patch batch12; no adaptive precision/batch fallback.
policy.repeat: First eligible crop/appearance/features input in each role. SFace exact; crop absolute1e-4, patches absolute/relative1e-4. Native source RGB must equal model-free audit.
policy.combination: Separate monotone local heads by target/view; one dependent video-face family, positive-logit maximum, then separately fitted and calibrated combination. No multiplication of independent votes.
policy.missing: Every planned unit retained; any unavailable required unit withholds combined confidence. No missing response becomes zero or an original verdict.
policy.points: Internal evaluation only. Across all four arms use the same completely assessed genuine fusion_cal source components, minimum25. Budget equals raw GenD genuine component false flags, capped atfloor(.1*n). Strict greater than sorted component maxima at rankn-budget. Local points match each existing raw cue in the same manner on common complete genuine files.
policy.comparison: Raw current-code cue arithmetic on exactly these fixed supports, not full production tracking/adaptive windows or whole application fusion.
policy.localization: Merge flagged support spans separated by at most550ms, for every arm and raw reference. Best merged-span IoU with known edit >=.3; separately count actually sampled flagged source frames and local-unit truth. Bridged gaps are interval estimates, not examined pixels.
policy.continuation: Require more AI files at no more genuine false-flag components than crop, no coverage loss, and more correctly localized manipulated clips at IoU>=.3 than crop. Report ordinary controls separately. No automatic serving adoption; fresh-source and full-app tests remain required.
